sources.independentAssessment: Reread the complete unchanged undated current guide and taxonomy: four domains, nine skills and 27 subskills. The data domain has its three service skills and 4/6/2 subskills. The guide establishes mapping and weights, not implementation accuracy or credential GA.

sources.title: Store and retrieve embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB
sources.independentAssessment: Reread the actual vector-index definitions and policy scope. flat compares original vectors and has a 505-dimension limit; quantizedFlat compresses vectors; diskANN is approximate. The explicit 1,000-vector effectiveness note bounds the repaired reference item. No unreliable cosine-score-direction or universal float16 no-loss claim is adopted.

sources.title: Use the change feed to trigger embedding refresh
sources.independentAssessment: Reread push/pull ownership, separate lease coordination and Python scheduled pull/continuation sections. These support model selection, not exactly-once side effects. The malformed illustrative start flag and token accessor are not adopted as executable APIs.

sources.independentAssessment: Reread asynchronous index addition, immediate loss of removed-index support and replacement ordering, alongside write-maintenance cost. Supports the two-stage rollout dependency; does not guarantee every unsupported ORDER BY falls back to a scan.

sources.title: Tune vector indexes for embedding workloads
sources.independentAssessment: Reread original/quantized/graph algorithm tradeoffs, flat dimensions and the 1,000-vector boundary. The repaired candidate does not rely on optional index tunable release status, generic speed claims or universal prefiltering.

sources.independentAssessment: Reread the transformation-monitoring section and explicit add/wait/remove guidance. Definition presence is not completed transformation. The reviewer does not adopt a specific SDK progress API, duration or query-cost guarantee.

sources.independentAssessment: Reread Session and cross-client application sections: tokens carry partition-specific position, separate clients require handoff, and unrelated sessions may be stale. sources.independentAssessment: Reread actual table/index relation-size functions, vector-payload estimate and MVCC old-version storage. These support measured live capacity and update headroom, not a universal HNSW multiplier or immediate space reclamation.
